Definition: to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be satiated or saturated, have or drink one's fill; 1a) (Qal) to take one's fill; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to be drunk, be intoxicated; 1b2) to drench, water abundantly, saturate; 1c) (Hiphil) to saturate, water, cause to drink
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
